none: PAS NLM-698C67: Roman Nummus Copy of House of Constantine from Wickenby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 10.7mm, Weight: 0.75gms, die axis: 12. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin
